name: Dead Tide IV: The Little Spermaid
source:
The vampiric Dread Pirate Queen Jessenia is in a cum coma and Gobonotik is left to his own devices. He rescues a damsel in distress and the greatest love story ever told ensues.

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-4-the-little-spermaid.html]Affect3D[/url]]
translation:
吸血鬼恐怖海盗女王杰塞尼娅陷入精液昏迷，戈博诺蒂克只得自行行动。他救下一位落难少女，一段史上最伟大的爱情故事就此展开。

[来自[url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-4-the-little-spermaid.html]Affect3D[/url]]
